headline: Not news: a Benzinga viewer poll on whether Tesla and SpaceX will merge
reasoning: Benzinga 15:05 UTC: 'EXCLUSIVE: Tesla SpaceX Merger? 70% of Benzinga Viewers Say Elon Musk Will Get There — But Not When You Think'.
Quoted from the body: 'Benzinga polled its "PreMarket Playbook" audience ... The latest poll included responses from 100 viewers.' It also cites Kalshi odds of 15% for a merger before Jan. 1, 2027.
Primary source: none. Neither Tesla nor SpaceX has announced or filed anything about a merger; the article is opinion about a possibility.
Nothing changed for the business. TSLA is -0.6% since the article, which is noise for this stock.
objections: Commentary: a 100-viewer poll about a hypothetical merger, with no company statement.
